notes:
Circuit: one single series loop, no branches at all. Going clockwise from the 50KV source: V-DC -> 9kOhm resistor -> 12mH inductor -> 9F capacitor -> 9mA current source (arrow pointing left) -> down the right side through the 60Ohm resistor -> back along the bottom rail, which carries the GND symbol, to the source's negative terminal. 7 components, 6 nets. There is also a hand-drawn page-border rectangle (x~12..1012, y~282..738) that touches no component and correctly ends up on no net.

NET MAP
  n1 = top lead of V-DC #4 (168,446) up the left vertical to the top-left corner (168,371) and right along the top rail to the left lead of R#0 (9kOhm) at (244,374). The corner ink is solid and continuous (verified by pixel dump at 168,372 - a filled elbow, no break), so edges e10 and e9 are one net.
  n2 = right lead of R#0 (377,394) to the left lead of inductor #2 (424,396).
  n5 = right lead of inductor #2 (559,403) to the left-plate lead of capacitor #3 (608,404).
  n3 = right-plate lead of capacitor #3 (685,405) to the left lead of I-DC #1 (744,404).
  n4 = right lead of I-DC #1 (838,405) to the top-right corner (~890,406) and down to the top lead of R#5 (60Ohm) at (892,474).
  0  = bottom lead of R#5 (901,593) down to the bottom-right corner (903,646), left along the long bottom rail y~647 to the bottom-left corner (177,647), up to the bottom lead of V-DC #4 (175,536); the GND symbol #6 T's onto that rail at (558,651).

JUDGEMENT CALLS: none of consequence. This sheet has NO CRITICAL intersection sites - the drafter drew a plain rectangular loop with no wire ever crossing another wire. All six sites the tracer reported (S1 624,351; S2 829,352; S3 775,354; S4 818,354; S7 91,489; S9 856,530) lie entirely inside handwritten value text - '9F' over the capacitor, '9mA' over the current source, '50KV' left of the source, and '60Ohm' left of the vertical resistor - and after the port fixes below none of them touches any component terminal. I recorded each explicitly as 'junction' (the tracer default) to document that I inspected all six crops; this changes nothing in the grouping. The 6 gap bridges are likewise all within those same label strokes (spans of 2-10 px between glyph fragments) and none is critical; none dropped.

PORT FIXES - this was the dominant defect on this sheet: six of the eight interior nets started as 1-terminal nets because three terminals had been parked on value-label ink.
  #1 I-DC: t0 sat on p1@(769,367), a stroke of the 'm' in '9mA' written across the top of the circle. Repointed to p4@(744,404), the real left lead - the wire run (e13, len 60) that comes straight from the capacitor's right plate. Ports p2@(834,364) and p3@(817,362) are the 'A' of '9mA' and stay unused; t1 stays on p0@(838,405), the real right lead.
  #3 Capacitor: t0 sat on p0@(615,365), the descender of the '9' in '9F'. Repointed to p2@(608,404), the real left-plate lead (wire e12, len 50, running back to the inductor). t1 stays on p1@(685,405).
  #4 V-DC: t0 sat on p2@(121,482), the 'V' of the '50KV' label. Repointed to p1@(168,446), the real top lead (wire e10, len 74, running up to the top-left corner). t1 stays on p0@(175,536), the bottom lead.
  #5 Resistor (60Ohm): p2@(872,535) is the 'Ohm' glyph of the '60Ohm' label; it was already correctly unused, terminals sit on p0 (top) and p1 (bottom). No override needed.
  After these three fixes every net has exactly two terminals except net 0 (three: V-DC bottom, 60Ohm bottom, GND), which is exactly what a single series loop with one ground reference should look like.

CLASSES: all seven symbols match their labels (R 9kOhm, L 12mH, C 9F, I-DC 9mA drawn as a circle with a left-pointing arrow, V-DC 50KV drawn as a circle with +/- bars, R 60Ohm, GND). No reclassification. Worth noting for the record that an ideal current source sits in series in the only loop - electrically an unusual textbook arrangement, but it is unambiguously what is drawn, so the GT reflects the drawing.

UNRESOLVED: nothing.
